sources.detail: All 6 pages (raid + M+ x DPS/Healer/Tank) fetched live by curl with a browser UA, HTTP 200, 212-371 KB each. Parsed <table class="tier-list">: first <td> = tier letter, each tier-list-entry block's first img alt = "Spec Class", looked up WHOLE against the roster (never split on whitespace). 80 assignments (40 raid + 40 M+), 0 unmatched, each spec exactly once per page; bands seen S/A+/A/B/C. ZERO tier moves. Page-own JSON-LD dateModified still 2026-06-30 / 2026-07-01, unchanged for ~5 weeks: this source's live S1 lists are static this late in the season, so a live re-verification producing zero moves is the expected result, not a stall.

All 3 PTR M+ pages (dps/healer/tank) fetched live, HTTP 200, 221-357 KB. Era-verified the OTHER way as the skill requires: every <title> reads "PTR Tier List for Midnight (Patch 12.1 / Season 2)". 38 rated rows (26 DPS + 7 healer + 5 tank) on the 6-band icyveins-ptr scale (S/A+/A/B+/B/C all present); the two upstream TBDs (Augmentation Evoker in the DPS list, Vengeance Demon Hunter in the tank list) were re-verified in the page body and written as explicit nulls, never omitted and never guessed — 40 rows applied. ZERO tier moves. WATCH ITEM, THIRD CONSECUTIVE RUN: published (JSON-LD dateModified, also the in-body "Last UPDATED - 26th of July") is STILL 2026-07-26 — now 9 days, and TWO Sunday-on-stream rebuild cycles have been missed (2026-08-02 and the 07-26 slot's successor). Still below the skill's ~2-week finding threshold but converging on it; nothing gates this by design (see SOURCES.md). Check it first next run.

Both pages fetched live by curl, HTTP 200 (165 KB M+ / 153 KB raid). 79 assignments (40 M+ + 39 raid), 0 unmatched roster rows. Vengeance DH remains absent from the raid list — the documented long-standing omission, left absent rather than invented. M+ bands A/B/C, raid S/A/B/C. Era-verified: Midnight and Devourer both present, no Season 2 / 12.1 self-identification; Method publishes no dateModified. ZERO tier moves. PARSER GOTCHA CAUGHT AND WORTH KEEPING: a findall of `<div class="tier__tier` with a lookahead terminating on the NEXT tier block or `</main` silently DROPS THE LAST TIER of each page — non-overlapping matches leave the final C-tier block with no terminator. That produced 29 raid rows instead of 39 (all 10 C-tier specs missing) and 7 of the 8 M+ dungeon labels, i.e. a clean-looking parse that had lost a whole band. Split the document on the marker instead of matching between markers. The 8 non-spec M+ labels are dungeon names (Windrunner Spire, Pit of Saron, Magister's Terrace, Maisara Caverns, Seat of the Triumvirate, Nexus Point Xenas, Skyreach, Algeth'ar Academy) and were correctly discarded.

All 6 pages fetched live, HTTP 200, 80-315 KB. Transport is the one the 08-03 run documented and it still works: r.jina.ai stays dead for wowhead.com/guide/* and plain curl with a UA alone is 403, but curl with a FULL browser header set (UA + Accept + Accept-Language + sec-ch-ua/-mobile/-platform + Sec-Fetch-Dest/Mode/Site/User + Upgrade-Insecure-Requests, --compressed) returns raw HTML. Parsed the embedded WH.markup [tier-list=rows] block (tier-label bg=qN + spec-badge=<spec-class-slug>) rather than the ordered-list prose, which sidesteps the hyphenated "(S-Tier)" hazard entirely; badge slugs map to the roster with no name splitting. 80 assignments (40 raid + 40 M+), 0 unmatched, 0 missing; the M+ DPS A+ band is present and correct. Era-verified per title: all six read "Midnight Season 1", Devourer present. ZERO tier moves. Page-own dateModified spans 2026-04-19 to 2026-06-25 (per page) — these lists have not been rebuilt in weeks, so zero moves is upstream cadence.

All 6 aggregate pages re-parsed from the __NEXT_DATA__ script tag in raw HTML (specTierListSection.tierLists): raid = the THROUGHPUT tierList, M+ = the SCORE tierList, never the default popularity grouping. 80 rows (27 DPS + 7 healer + 6 tank per bracket), 0 unmatched icons. ZERO tier moves. ON THE DATE: Archon's own lastUpdated still reads 2026-08-03T12:00:00Z at 12:35Z today — the 08-04 daily aggregate had not published yet. Per the 2026-08-01 finding, that field is a COARSE DAILY LABEL and not a change detector: the numeric series underneath it DID move this run (see archon-metrics), which is independent evidence this is a live fetch of fresh data rather than a cached copy. The stored snapshot is therefore the fetch date, as it has been for every prior run of this source.

Full re-fetch of all 9 Venomous-era raid bosses (throughput) + 8 M+ dungeons (score) x 3 roles = 51 pages, every one HTTP 200 with a parseable __NEXT_DATA__ blob and every encounter yielding all 40 specs. 680 tier rows rewritten to data/encounter-tiers.json (asOf 2026-08-04), stored display names preserved because Archon's page title field is the generic list title rather than the encounter name. 24 of 680 rows moved (3.5%) — normal daily variation, and ALL 24 are raid-side: imperator 6 (Marksmanship Hunter and Windwalker Monk A->S, Frost Mage / Subtlety Rogue / Devastation Evoker B->A, Retribution Paladin C->B), chimaerus 6 (Feral Druid / Devourer DH / Elemental Shaman A->S, Discipline Priest S->A, Preservation Evoker and Restoration Shaman A->B), beloren 5 (Destruction Warlock, Retribution and Protection Paladin, Protection Warrior A->B, Brewmaster C->B), crown 3, salhadaar 2, vaelgor-ezzorak 2. All 8 dungeons unchanged.

Kept to the stored convention of DPS + tank specs only — the raid healer page also exposes a dps column and ingesting it would silently widen the series to 40; healers publish under the HPS name instead. 30 of 33 values MOVED this run, all fractionally (e.g. Augmentation Evoker 183960 -> 184315, Frost DK 174787 -> 175097, Arcane Mage 160145 -> 159416, Survival Hunter 177164 -> 176963). That movement under an unchanged lastUpdated label is the documented 2026-08-01 behaviour and is what confirms the fetch was live.

The score column is integer-valued and held steady across the roster this run while the raid DPS series moved — consistent with the M+ aggregate being coarser, not with a stalled fetch (parse counts advanced).

80 rows (40 raid + 40 M+) parsed from specRankingsSection.table.data[].popularity as fraction x 100, rounded to the stored 1-decimal convention. A handful moved by 0.1 (Blood DK raid 29.2 -> 29.5, Guardian Druid 17.4 -> 17.3, Survival Hunter 1.8 -> 1.7); the rest held at 1-decimal precision.

PARTIAL because the upstream snapshotDate is STILL 2026-07-28 — now 7 days behind this run and unchanged for the seventh consecutive day; manifest.completedAt likewise pins the upstream pipeline's last finish at 2026-07-28T22:06:44.110Z, byte-identical to the value read on 07-31 and 08-03. asOf must be the source's own date, never today, so the stored rows correctly stay at 07-28 and 0 values changed. ESCALATION: this requirement's maxAgeDays is 8, so at 7 days it is inside the threshold today and BREACHES on 2026-08-06 if the upstream pipeline does not run. The pattern now looks like a stalled pipeline rather than a slow cadence — worth a human deciding whether to raise the threshold again or accept the alert.

40/40 rows (27 DPS + 7 healer + 6 tank) by plain GET on the three /meta/<role>/m+ pages, HTTP 200, 41-72 KB (r.jina.ai does not work on murlok). Parsed the meta-item cards: the second .h3 in each block is the "Spec Class" label (the first is the rank number) and the rating is the number after the </svg> in the infobar <li>. ZERO values moved — third consecutive run reading them unchanged, consistent with late-season top-50 pools that have stopped turning over. NEW PARSER GOTCHA, cost a silent 5-spec shortfall before it was caught: murlok emits BOTH attribute orders on the card anchor — `<a class="... meta-item ..." href=...>` and `<a href=... class="... meta-item ...">`. A splitter anchored on `<a class=` matched only the first form and returned 35 of 40 rows (Blood DK, Devastation Evoker, Preservation Evoker, Subtlety Rogue, Arms Warrior missing) while reporting 0 unmatched. Split on `<a [^>]*meta-item` instead.
